   **Precio y paywall.**

      Ventana de reseñas: 16 sept 2026 - 16 sept 2026

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 2 feb 2026 - 13 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Miles Roche_, 2 feb 2026, 4/5: "This is an amazing app! I love the ui design and feel. It is perfect apart from a few minor/annoying bugs I have found. Apart from those, its perfect! I've noticed that you can't change the order of the tasks in checklists or rename them without starting again, and the back button during the workout menu doesn't work. ilI would also love to see some improvement of the actual workouts. If I could change the reps and weights without having to go back and edit the workout it would be much better."
<!--/ir-theme-->
